purpose: Reproducible, security-reviewed project skill provenance for Field Hours

installed.name: accessibility
constraints: Use as evidence-led WCAG guidance; automated tools do not replace manual keyboard and screen-reader checks.
Any optional npm, npx, Lighthouse, axe, or browser command remains subject to project permissions and verification rules.

installed.name: supabase-postgres-best-practices
constraints: Apply only to PostgreSQL/Supabase, never to Cloudflare D1/SQLite.
Treat SQL snippets as review material, not as authorization to execute them.
Project database-design, security, backup, rollback, migration, and production-approval rules take precedence.
Verify privileged, destructive, RLS, and role-management examples against current official documentation before use.

reviewed_not_installed.name: composition-patterns
reviewed_not_installed.reason: General rules leak React 19-only APIs and contain internally invalid examples, while Field Hours uses React 18.3.1.

reviewed_not_installed.name: playwright-best-practices
reviewed_not_installed.reason: Guidance includes destructive database/filesystem operations, external artifact uploads, and examples incompatible with the project's Playwright configuration.
